visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit studio kitchen setting, a male host with short hair, wearing a backwards purple baseball cap and a black t-shirt, stands behind a wooden counter. Behind him, stainless steel shelves hold various metal pots, pans, and a potted green plant. Large text overlays introduce the 7-Eleven and Chef Baek Jong-won collaboration with bright graphics. (2) The scene shifts to close-ups of packaged meals being opened. The host uses a metal spoon to lift a portion of orange-tinted risotto from a black plastic container, showing melted cheese stretching from the rice. He puts the food in his mouth, chews thoughtfully, and gestures with his hands while speaking excitedly to the camera. (3) The host holds a triangular seaweed-wrapped rice ball. He peels off the plastic wrapper, causing small crinkles in the film visible to the eye. A close-up shows him biting into the rice ball, revealing a reddish-brown seafood sauce filling inside. He points at the cross-section of the rice ball to emphasize the texture and quantity of the sauce. (4) The host interacts with a bowl of pasta, stirring the cream sauce and beef toppings with a fork. He later bites into a thick-sliced toasted sandwich filled with ham and egg, showing a satisfied facial expression. He then picks up a bottle of orange-colored juice, takes a sip, and gives a thumbs-up while holding the product. (5) The host is shown in a montage preparing a custom dish using the collaboration ingredients. He wears white gloves and uses a red spatula to stir-fry rice and eggs on a black flat griddle over a portable gas stove. He adds noodles and chicken pieces, creating steam. The final dish is a flat, crispy rice pancake topped with seaweed flakes. (6) The video concludes with a wide shot of all the collaboration products arranged on a table. The host stands behind them, smiling and making inviting gestures with his hands toward the viewer. Logo overlays for 7-Eleven and Chef Baek appear prominently as the video ends with a celebratory visual tone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy male greeting. An upbeat electronic pop background music with a tempo around 120 BPM starts immediately, featuring clean synth chords and a driving percussion line. The speaker's voice is well-projected with a high pitch variability, indicating excitement and engagement as he introduces the unboxing topic. (2) A sharp, percussive clink of a metal spoon hitting a black plastic container marks the start of this phase. The speaker continues his high-arousal narration, describing the risotto with rich vocal intonation. The background music remains constant in the background, mixed slightly lower than the voice to ensure clarity. There are no significant ambient noises audible. (3) The acoustic texture shifts as the sound of plastic film rustling and tearing becomes dominant while a rice ball is unwrapped. This is followed by a short silence and then the muffled sound of chewing. The speaker's voice returns with a sharp rising intonation as he reacts to the taste, showing high emotional valence. (4) A major transition occurs with the onset of a loud, high-frequency sizzling sound from food frying. The rhythmic, metallic scraping of a spatula against a griddle adds sharp transients to the mix. The speaker's voice remains energetic, cutting through the cooking noise with professional clarity and high intensity while explaining the custom recipe steps. (5) The sizzling sound ceases, replaced by the speaker's final promotional remarks about the brand collaboration. The background music volume swells momentarily, emphasizing the concluding brand slogan. The speaker's tone is friendly and commanding, with a moderate speech rate and natural falling intonation patterns to signal the end of the video segment clearly.
